title: 第21章 系统发布任务新弟子出现第22章 救下敖绝神
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
此时，陆玄合与赵凡师兄弟已经回到道阳峰弟子洞府区域了。
“师兄，我感觉我在闭关几天，就能突破到元神境二重天了。”
“恭喜师弟再进一步！”
“师兄就别笑话我了，宗内的秘境很适合磨练我们。
师兄应该也要突破了吧？”
“我和师弟你差不多，感觉瓶颈已经松动了，或许能在师尊所说的元兽秘境试炼前，突破到元神境五重天。”
二人一边交流，一边走向自己洞府。
由于师兄弟俩的洞府都挨在一起，直到走进各自洞府后，这才分开。
......
道阳峰后山。
对于道极宗内发生的一切，秦天阳是知道的，无他，帝尊神念太过强横。
当试炼峰钟声响起的那一刻，秦天阳就已经知晓了一切。
“两小子还是不错的。”
秦天阳收回神念。
“经过这番磨练，两人的瓶颈应该松动了。”
“再闭关几天，应该能赶在元兽秘境试炼之前突破！”
......
五天后。
道阳峰。
后山。

秦天阳见时辰到了，于是唤来刚好已经出关的陆玄合与赵凡。
两人都毫无意外地突破了。
陆玄合目前是元神境五重天。
赵凡是元神境二重天。
“不错！
不仅实力进步迅速，而且根基很稳！”
秦天阳用帝尊神念一扫二人，便知道了一切情况。
陆玄合与赵凡的基础很稳，并没有境界虚浮的现象发生。
不仅同阶无敌，还能越境对敌，甚至将其击败。
【叮！
【检测到紫色资质天骄！
【系统发布任务：请宿主前往东荒域的东荒山脉收徒！
【请问宿主是否接取任务？】
就在秦天阳准备带着陆玄合与赵凡二人前往道极宗主殿与道极宗主等人会合时。
突然，一道系统声音在秦天阳脑海中响起！
“嗯？又有一名紫色资质的天骄？”
秦天阳目视着只有他才能看到的面板，眼中闪过一抹兴奋。
他才收下赵凡半个月，系统就又给他送弟子来了。
content_en:
At this time, brothers Lu Xuanhe and Zhao Fan had returned to the Daoyang Peak disciple cave area.
"Senior Brother, I feel that I can break through to the second level of the Yuanshen Realm after a few days of seclusion."
"Congratulations, junior brother, for taking another step forward!"
"Senior brother, please don't laugh at me. The secret realm within the sect is very suitable for training us.
Senior brother should also be able to break through, right? "
"Junior brother and I are about the same. I feel that the bottleneck has been loosened. Maybe I can break through to the fifth level of the Yuanshen Realm before the trial of the Yuan Beast Secret Realm that Master mentioned."
The two communicated while walking towards their cave.
Since the caves of the two brothers were next to each other, they didn't separate until they entered their respective caves.
...
The mountain behind Daoyang Peak.
Qin Tianyang knew everything that happened in Daoji Sect. Without him, Emperor Zun's spiritual thoughts were too overbearing.
The moment the bell of Trial Peak rang, Qin Tianyang already knew everything.
"The two boys are pretty good."
Qin Tianyang withdrew his spiritual thoughts.
"After this training, the bottleneck between the two of them should be loosened."
"If I stay in seclusion for a few more days, I should be able to break through before the trial in the Yuan Beast Secret Realm!"
...
Five days later.
Daoyang Peak.
Back mountain.
Qin Tianyang saw that the time had come, so he called Lu Xuanhe and Zhao Fan, who had just come out of seclusion.
Both men broke through without any surprise.
Lu Xuanhe is currently at the fifth level of the Yuanshen Realm.
Zhao Fan is at the second level of the Yuanshen Realm.
"Not bad!
Not only is the strength improving rapidly, but the foundation is very stable! "
Qin Tianyang used the Emperor's Divine Mind to scan the two of them and knew everything.
The foundations of Lu Xuanhe and Zhao Fan are very stable, and there is no phenomenon of emptiness in their realm.
Not only is it invincible at the same level, it can also cross borders to confront enemies and even defeat them.
【bite!
[Purple Qualified Talent Detected!
[The system issues a mission: Ask the host to go to the Donghuang Mountains in the Donghuang Territory to recruit disciples!
[Will the host accept the task? 】
Just when Qin Tianyang was about to take Lu Xuanhe and Zhao Fan to the Daoji Sect Master's Hall to meet with the Daoji Sect Master and others.
Suddenly, a system voice sounded in Qin Tianyang's mind!
"Huh? Is there another genius with purple qualifications?"
Qin Tianyang looked at the panel that only he could see, with a flash of excitement in his eyes.
He had only accepted Zhao Fan for half a month, and the system had already sent him another disciple.
